One Pot Masala Khichdi Recipe 
This dish is definitely near and dear to my heart because of these reasons- comfort that it reminds me of home, simplicity of ingredients, ease because it’s so simple to make and comes together in minutes 

Nutrition: 
C: 71 | F: 5 | P: 19
Calories: 410 per portion 
Makes 2 or 3 portions

Ingredients: 
80 grams basmati rice + 100 grams dal (toor or masoor), rinsed till water runs clear and soaked for 30 minutes 
1 tsp mustard seeds
1 tsp jeera seeds
pinch of hing
1 onion, finely chopped
1 tsp ginger garlic paste
2 tomato, finely chopped
1 green chillies, finely chopped
10-12 curry leaves
1 1/2 tsp haldi
1 1/2 tsp red chilli powder
1 tsp garam masala
1 tsp coriander powder
salt, to taste
around 500 - 600 ml water, should completely submerge 

-Chopped coriander, for garnish

Method: 
add your ghee to the pressure cooker followed by mustard seeds, allow to pop then add in the cumin seeds and stir together
add in the onion, ggp paste, chilli and curry leaves, cook till onions are translucent
add in all the masalas and stir for a few minutes, it gets dry and can burn so add in a few tbsp of water
add in the tomatoes and cook for a few minutes
then add in your dal + rice and stir for 2-3 minutes, this roasts it slightly and adds the flavour
pour in the water and pressure cook on low for 3 whistles 
allow the pressure cooker to release then open mix together, add the salt and stir in your fresh coriander at the end
